SEAT RE | status: DONE
did: T20 - full (kind,role) pair sweep over all 46,052 restored functions, plus the damage filter and the Faction class. Every address below is from this IDB.
evidence:
(1) PAIR TABLE - every function <=0x110 that tests and 0x1F8, with the kind test beside it: (3,1) Guard sub_73B4B0@0x73b4b0; (3,29) sub_19709F0@0x19709f0 = despawn bookkeeping, decrements this+74 vs this+73; (2,2) Civilian sub_54EC00@0x54ec00; (2,19) Animal, 9 sites @0x15d3a20,0x19c3ef0,0x1113c60,0x1113d30,0x12393e0,0x13120d0,0x1650d50,0x1650e30,0x169b410; (2,6) Target @0x16a16a0 (clears bit 8 at +992); (1|2,18) Lite @0x1a49770. NOTHING tests role 3 Thief or role 5 Mercenary - no role predicate exists for them, so they cannot be added to the filter by role.
(2) Damage filter sub_17106C0@0x17106c0: if the victim is (kind2, role19 Animal), only attacker roles {3,5,6,14,23,25,26} with damage type 3/6/14 pass; it reads the ATTACKER role from a4+16. Combined with sub_133F630 (kind-only friendly fire) this proves hostility is decided by kind + faction, never by role.
(3) bits 9-14 = variant, set independently by 0x4EDCF0, used as a subtype selector: sub_15d3a20 compares (v>>9) and 0x3F against a stored id inside the (kind2, role19 Animal) branch. It does NOT encode faction.
(4) Faction is a separate object. ctor sub_19123B0@0x19123b0: *a1 = andoff_27043E0, *(a1+8) = 0 (the NAME pointer, zeroed), containers at +12/+20; dtor sub_1910AF0. Getter chain: sub_6F5F70@0x6f5f70 = *(*(entity+0xE8)+0x1C) then sub_133A4C0@0x133a4c0 returns *(char_+0xA4) after handle test sub_F916A0. Name is a char* at faction+8.
(5) Writer of char_+0xA4: UNPROVEN. None of the 41 callers of sub_6F5F70 stores +0xA4, and the Faction ctor has ZERO xrefs - Faction objects are built through the data/descriptor path, not a SetFaction C++ call. The attach happens during character setup, not in a function we can hook cleanly.
next: for hostile-to-player use kind==3 (inference, not proof) plus the faction name at *(faction+8); prove both in one dump before shipping.
